dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit dark, high-contrast outer perimeters with a sharp gradient transition to lighter interior pigmentation; the most prominent dorsal annulus displays an elliptical geometry with a well-defined dark border.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid low-intensity dark clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily situated in the interstitial spaces between macro-annuli along the mid-lateral line.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal-lateral macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle with the longest edge oriented longitudinally; several smaller high-intensity blobs are distributed in an irregular linear arrangement ventral to this triangle.
